method.calibration: Use the second-highest genuine work maximum from 20 earlier GAO reports. Do not reuse edits for threshold fitting. Reuse 20 later previously measured report works as transfer and reserve an available unused-work follow-up.
method.criterion: At least four new useful locations on three works and both generators with at most two new untouched flags. Requires a separate fresh assessment before serving.
method.localization: Select a unique highest interior value strictly above its frozen point. Keep the incumbent three-sentence ranges at its original 0.50 point as the baseline. Report outright wins, wrong locations, and paired gains versus a highest-native-center selector.
method.native: Read exact left-middle-right text. Each score concerns all three sentences.
method.rotated: Read all three cyclic rotations of the same sentences. Keep original middle score minus the mean of the two rotations where each neighbor occupies the middle. These alternate inputs are diagnostic and their responses do not measure independent authorship.
